slides.headline: the *moon* is in scorpio. so is venus. text carefully
a waning moon in *scorpio*: feelings run deep and quiet
slides.body: the moon is a thin crescent before dawn, heading for new moon on tuesday. reads as a day for one honest talk, not a group chat.

slides.headline: *mercury* enters sagittarius. bluntness is back
slides.body: mercury moves from scorpio to sagittarius early sunday. astrologers read it as conversations getting faster, funnier and a lot less filtered.

slides.headline: one thing: ask what you *actually* want to know
